# Issue 17 slice 3 — cross-corpus package handoff

Implemented five sourced cards that were missing names in the exact desired
lists, plus **Guttersnipe** with a complete controller-only spell-cast trigger.
No commit/push. Full #17 incomplete; desired lists unchanged.

## Cards and sources

From stored real Scryfall planned-list printing responses, retrieved
`2026-10-25T08:32:00Z` (`fixtures/starter-corpus/cross-package-sourced.json`):

| card | printing | text implemented |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Swamp | mdd/296 | Basic Land — Swamp, `{T}: Add {B}` |
| Lightning Bolt | msc/806 | `{R}` instant, 3 damage to any target |
| Forest Bear | ptk/135 | `{1}{G}` 2/2 vanilla Bear |
| Striped Bears | wth/140 | `{3}{G}` 2/2 Bear; ETB draw a card |
| Guttersnipe | hoc/196 | `{2}{R}` 2/2 Goblin Shaman; whenever you cast an instant/sorcery, deals 2 damage to each opponent |

Pool 88 → **93**. Swamp closes the black-basic-land gap; Elas still has 58
missing names.

## Genuine RED / GREEN

1. Cards absent: all five tests failed at catalog lookup (source + behavior).
2. After compile/scaffold entries:
   * `forest_bear_is_vanilla_and_striped_bears_draws_on_entry` — hand count
     `0` vs expected `1` (no ETB draw).
   * `guttersnipe_hits_each_opponent_but_not_its_controller` — P2 life `17`
     vs expected `15` (no trigger damage).
   * source-left Guttersnipe test also failed until the trigger/effect existed.
3. Fix: Striped Bears typed ETB Draw; Guttersnipe typed SpellCast trigger with
   `Effect::DamageEachOpponent(2)` (live opponents only, controller excluded,
   damage source is the ability source, source-left resolution preserved by the
   existing stack/trigger scheduler). No priority is granted mid-effect.
4. GREEN: 5/5 cross-package tests, including 4-seat each-opponent damage and
   source-left-by-Unsummon damage.

## Verification

```
cargo test -q -p aperture-core --test issue17_cross_package --test issue17_tatyova \
  --test issue17_tokens --test issue17_talrand --test card_printings \
  --test catalog_pool --test issue13_commander_combat \
  -p aperture-import --test starter_corpus_planned
  -> 5, 5, 10, 6, 4, 5, 43, 1 passed
cargo test -q -p aperture-cli
  -> 8 + 1 passed
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo build --release -p aperture-cli
  -> exit 0
```

## Four-seat package journey

`decks/package-cross-corpus.txt` is a clearly named **40-card supported package
fixture**, not a desired starter. Four seats, ordinary practice, seed 5:

* terminal, P2 wins, 1112 steps / 25 turns, digest `4572cd11e893…`
* **8 Guttersnipe spell-cast triggers** in the log; actual damage to each live
  opponent; no controller damage
* replay digest matches; `--save-out` save replays to the same digest
* the earlier attempt with a removal-heavy build produced no Guttersnipe triggers
  (preserved in git-less evidence history by rerun); the final package uses
  Opt/Consider/Divination so the AI actually casts spells

Existing Tatyova replay still reproduces `b31adfd97c31…`.

## Corpus accounting

Coordinator audit script updated for `card_defender!` and rerun:

* catalog **93**; union **459**; supported **81**; missing **378**;
  manifest missing **378** and matches the exact names.
* Per-list missing: Isamaru 57, Jasmine 0, Talrand 54, Krenko 51, Ayula 50,
  Elas 58, Tatyova 56, Zada 57.
* All eight exact desired list files unchanged.

## Remaining gaps

* No desired 100-card starter is complete; all seven non-Jasmine lists remain
  planned/unsupported.
* Guttersnipe support is the printed trigger + damage primitive only; no
  additional Guttersnipe-like cards were added.
* Ayula vanilla/ETB additions beyond Forest Bear/Striped Bears were not added
  within the time budget.
* Legend rule, broader landfall/ramp, tokens beyond Goblin/Drake, counters and
  tribal payoffs remain unimplemented.

Changed: `crates/core/src/{card,catalog,ability,engine}.rs`,
`crates/core/tests/{issue17_cross_package,catalog_pool,card_printings,issue13_commander_combat}.rs`,

details.oldText:
# Issue 17 — supported starter corpus

Status: **PARTIAL**. One starter package is implemented and exercised; the
eight-list release gate in the public issue remains open. Only
`jasmine-vanilla-stompy` is supported. Every other entry below is a **planned**
archetype with an exact sourced **desired** list under
`decks/starter-corpus/planned/`, and **no** claimed card support, playability or
certification.

The machine-readable target list is
`decks/starter-corpus/manifest.json` (schema `version: 1`). Its `status` field is
`planned`, `implemented` or `certified`; planned entries have a non-null
`deck_path` pointing at their exact desired 99-card library, but remain
engine-unsupported and non-playable. `deck_path` is not a support claim.

## Target archetypes

| id | commander | style | status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isamaru-white-aggro` | Isamaru, Hound of Konda | white aggressive one-drop | planned |
| `jasmine-vanilla-stompy` | Jasmine Boreal | green/white vanilla-creature stompy | implemented |
| `talrand-draw-go` | Talrand, Sky Summoner | blue draw-go spells-matter | planned |
| `krenko-goblin-tokens` | Krenko, Mob Boss | red goblin token swarm | planned |
| `ayula-bear-counters` | Ayula, Queen Among Bears | green bear tribal +1/+1 counters | planned |
| `elas-sacrifice` | Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim | white/black sacrifice/drain | planned |
| `tatyova-landfall` | Tatyova, Benthic Druid | green/blue landfall value | planned |
| `zada-spells` | Zada, Hedron Grinder | red single-target spell copying | planned |

All eight entries now have an exact desired 99-card library file. Only Jasmine's
is supported and playable; the other seven are **planned metadata**, never
supported defaults. Their `deck_path` points under
`decks/starter-corpus/planned/`, and their cards are mostly outside the current
88-card pool. Isamaru itself is supported, but none of its 57 chosen nonland
cards is, so `isamaru-white-aggro` stays `planned`.

## Corpus union and staged gaps

Exact all-name totals over the eight desired lists, including commanders and
basic lands (coordinator evidence
`evidence/issue17/slice3-native-corpus.py/json`):

* union of all referenced names: **459 unique names**;
* **81** are in the supported 93-card catalog and **378** are missing;
* the manifest's `missing_cards` per list is computed from the same catalog
  membership and sums to the same verified contents. Planned lists remain
  metadata only; Jasmine is the only implemented/playable starter.
* Structure per list is still 99 library cards + a separately named commander;
  the Swamp basic in Elas is now supported, but the rest of that desired list
  still needs its unsupported cards and interactions.

Staged interaction roadmap (derived from the manifest `missing_interactions`):

1. tokens and token permanents: **partially implemented** as typed 1/1 red
   Goblin tokens for the Krenko package (Krenko, Dragon Fodder, Krenko's
   Command, Hordeling Outburst, Goblin Instigator, Beetleback Chief) and a 2/2
   blue Drake with functional flying for Talrand, Sky Summoner. Ayula and Zada
   still need their own token types; the exact Krenko starter is still planned
   (52 missing) and Talrand's desired list has 54 missing cards;
2. triggered abilities: **bounded implemented package** for Talrand's
   controller-only instant/sorcery cast trigger (staged above the spell,
   independent of counters) and **bounded implemented** landfall for Tatyova and
   Jaddi Offshoot (life then draw, controller-only). Death and tribal triggers
   remain unimplemented (Elas, Ayula);
3. activated non-mana abilities: **bounded implemented package** for Krenko's
   `{T}` Goblin-count token production (including >255 counts) and the existing
   Prodigal Sorcerer/Rootwalla/Brindle Boar abilities. Sacrifice outlets and
   broader activated abilities remain unimplemented (Elas);
4. keyword semantics (haste for Krenko);
5. counters as rules objects (Ayula);
6. single-target spell copying and go-wide pump (Zada);
7. legend rule, equipment and Aura permanents (Isamaru and any future legend);
8. black basic land support (Elas): **implemented** as the sourced Swamp basic;

A further count gap: the current pool has no black basic land, so Elas cannot
be constructed even as a legal 99-card practice library until `Swamp` is added.
None of these planned lists is called supported, legal-for-play or certified.

## First implemented package: jasmine-vanilla-stompy

* Commander: **Jasmine Boreal** — `{3}{G}{W}`, legendary 4/5 Human with no rules
  text. It is a genuine printed vanilla legend and is registered in the typed
  `CardId::SUPPORTED_COMMANDERS` allow-list next to Isamaru.
* Library: **99 cards** in
  `decks/starter-corpus/jasmine-vanilla-stompy.txt`, commander supplied
  separately:
  * **58 unique nonland cards**, all singleton, all supported: 47 newly sourced
    vanilla green/white creatures, 11 previously supported green/white
    nonland cards (four vanilla creatures, four instants, three creatures with
    already-tested typed abilities);
  * **41 basic lands**: 20 Plains and 21 Forest.
* Total with the commander: 100 cards. No card in the library is legendary, so
  the unimplemented legend rule is never exercised. No nonbasic singleton card
  is duplicated. There is no snow, artifact, enchantment creature, token,
  counter, keyword or unsupported rules text in the package.
* Sourced printings: `fixtures/starter-corpus/sourced-cards.json` records the
  concrete Scryfall printing, printing URL, Oracle fields and retrieval time for
  every referenced card. Raw provider responses are in
  `evidence/issue17/scryfall-responses.json`.
* Offline analyzer snapshots: `fixtures/starter-corpus/` contains the
  `aperture.commander-deck.v1` list snapshot, the
  `aperture.card-metadata.v1` card snapshot and a fixture manifest with the
  bound SHA-256 digests. These use the existing `commander-check` analyzer; no
  parallel legality engine was added.

Reproduce the source capture and snapshots:

```
python evidence/issue17/source-starter-cards.py
python evidence/issue17/generate-starter-fixtures.py
cargo run -p aperture-cli -- commander-check \
  --deck fixtures/starter-corpus/jasmine-vanilla-stompy.deck.json \
  --cards fixtures/starter-corpus/jasmine-vanilla-stompy.cards.json --json
```

The analyzer reports format legality `legal`, one commander, 99 library cards,
100 total, 61 unique canonical names and engine support `supported`. Its
`gameplay.available` field remains `false` with the pre-existing blanket reasons;
that refusal was deliberately not relaxed. Bounded command-zone and
Commander-combat practice are still **not** the Commander format.

## Phased gaps (why the eight-list gate is open)

1. **Card-support surface.** The implemented pool is 88 cards. Non-vanilla
   archetypes need token creation, activated abilities beyond land mana,
   triggered abilities, keyword semantics, counters as rules objects and
   static/layer effects that this slice does not implement. Those are the
   `missing_interactions` entries in the manifest.
2. **Commanders.** Six target commanders are not in the supported pool.
   Extending the typed registry is deliberately explicit: adding a name to
   `SUPPORTED_COMMANDERS` without implementing its printed text would fake
   support.
3. **Exact lists.** Every planned target has an exact sourced desired list under
   `decks/starter-corpus/planned/`, and its `deck_path` points at it. Jasmine's
   implemented list is directly under `decks/starter-corpus/`.
   A desired-list path is a planning artifact, not support: every planned list is
   engine-unsupported, non-playable and non-certified. Jasmine is the only list
   built entirely from supported cards; Tatyova now has a bounded landfall
   package (Tatyova, Benthic Druid + Jaddi Offshoot with defender). A 90-land pile or duplicated nonbasic
   singleton cards would not be a meaningful style and is not used to satisfy
   counts.
4. **Certification.** `implemented` means an exact list exists, is analyzer
   legal/supported and has played an exact four-seat bounded game. It does not
   mean eight-list certification, independent review or merged CI.

## Exclusion policy

* Only cards whose complete printed text maps to implemented engine semantics
  may enter the catalog. Unsupported text means the card is refused, never
  approximated.
* Genuine vanilla creatures are preferred for volume: they add no hidden
  keyword, token, counter or replacement semantics.
* Legendary cards are commander-only. The legend rule is not modelled, so a
  supported commander is refused in ordinary starting libraries and no other
  legend may enter a starter library.
* Nonbasic singleton cards may appear once per list. Basic lands are the only
  repeatable cards.
* Source data must come from an authoritative printing (Scryfall printing
  endpoint or official Gatherer) with a retrieval date. No card name, cost,
  type line, power/toughness or Oracle text is authored by hand.
* Format legality, engine support and actual gameplay support are reported
  separately. A legal/supported list is still not Commander format gameplay.

## Practical limitations

* The game/replay journey is a local 2–4-seat deterministic heuristic run under
  the explicit bounded 40-life Commander-combat practice profile; it is not
  networked multiplayer or full Commander.
* The AI is the existing deterministic heuristic. This package adds no
  strategy tuning.
* The native UI's bundled table still defaults to the practice decks; the
  starter corpus is exercised through the CLI with explicit deck paths.

  counters", but only object counters are typed and stored. Nothing in the 28-card
  pool puts a counter on a player (no poison, experience, energy or commander tax
  counter is modelled), so player counters are deliberately absent rather than
  approximated.
* Save/replay compatibility at `SAVE_VERSION` 10 / `REPLAY_VERSION` 6: a pre-#16
  save has no `counters` and no `revealed` key. Both fields are
  `#[serde(default)]`, so such a save still loads with empty counters, and an
  empty value is skipped when serializing, so a state that uses neither keeps its
  pre-#16 serialized form and digest — old replays still verify instead of
  failing as digest mismatches. A malformed counters payload (zero-count kind,
  unknown kind, negative count, wrong JSON type) is refused as a load error and
  never silently repaired.
* Creature tokens are rules objects (`crates/core/src/tokens.rs`, CR 111):
  owned/controlled by their creator, summoning sick, cease to exist on any

  characteristics live outside the importable pool, so a token can never be

# Issue 17 slice 7 — S6-R2-F1 repair + master integration handoff

No push. Full #17 unfinished; 8 desired, 1 implemented, 0 certified.

## Commits

* `f1b7ab6` — `fix(core): dispatch each self-death trigger once (S6-R2-F1)`
* `edd8008` — merge `origin/master` `8de0961370c595f82f3e1d7505b37c7e67958183`
  into `aperture/issue-17` (two-parent integration commit)
* Backup branch: `issue17-pre-slice7-rebase` at `f1b7ab6`
* Pre-merge feature head: `3987dd6`

## S6-R2-F1

Reproduced reviewer224's probe: `[22,18,18,18]` instead of `[21,19,19,19]` for
one dying Zulaport and `[23,17,17,17]` instead of `[22,18,18,18]` for
Zulaport+Jackal. Root cause: `move_to_graveyard_inner` queued the self-death
trigger, then the watcher batch dispatched the same dying object again.

Fix: the watcher batch now carries the **original battlefield ObjectId** and
skips the dying watcher's own death, because `queue_self_death` already queued
it. Surviving watchers still see every other death. Three probe tests were
ported into `issue17_slice6.rs` (both death orders, single dying watcher,
surviving watcher control) and all assert full drain (stack, trigger_queue,
resolving, pending empty) and exact life totals. External probe:
RED in `review224-probe/output.log`, GREEN in `output-green.log` /
`output-merged-green.log` (3/3).

## Integration

Fetched with command-scoped credential override: `origin/master` =
`8de0961` (#16 typed counters, tokens, keywords, library operations). Rebase
would require a forbidden force push, so used the documented merge fallback.
Conflicts: `HANDOFF.md`, `README.md`, `card.rs`, `catalog.rs`, `engine.rs`,
`state.rs`. Resolutions:

* Kept all corpus cards/variants and master `SoldierToken`/`SpiritToken`;
  unified `CardId::is_token` over all four engine tokens.
* Adopted master’s typed counter/token/keyword engine where it superseded the
  duplicate local token machinery; extended `tokens::keywords` for Drake
  (flying) and Jaddi (defender).
* Resolved token death/bounce/exile tests to the merged #16 token architecture
  (immediate cessation, object removed, `token ... dies and ceases` event).
  This is disclosed integration behavior change, not silently rewritten history.
* Added required `counters` field to corpus test object literals.
* Docs: kept branch corpus/README content for conflicts.

## Verification

* Focused merged tests: slice6 13/13, cross 6/6 (later 8/8 before merge-specific
  field adaptation), Tatyova 5/5, tokens 10/10, Talrand 7/7, starter 8/8,
  catalog 5/5, printings 8/8; external probe 3/3.
* `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`,
  release CLI build: exit 0 (`slice7-gates.log`).
* Real four-seat package journey (`decks/package-slice6-dies.txt`, 40-card
  package, not a desired starter, seed 610): terminal, P3 wins, 2952 steps /
  66 turns, digest `8e0ab4b00e7f…`; separate replay matches 7239 events.
  This digest differs from the pre-integration slice6 `7864e4e9…`, recorded
  honestly; no old digest was rewritten.
* Corpus audit after merge: catalog 93, union 459, supported 81, missing 378,
  manifest matches (`slice3-native-corpus.json`).

## Unfinished

Full desired-starter certification is still open; no new feature cards were
added in this assignment. Token semantics changed to the merged #16 architecture
(immediate cessation); prior CR111.7 real-destination behavior is superseded
and disclosed. Required CI/independent review remain coordinator-owned.

# Issue 17 slice 8 — cross-list missing-card package handoff

Eight real missing cards from the exact desired lists are now supported, using
existing effects plus six bounded reusable primitives. No push. Full #17
unfinished; eight desired, one implemented, zero certified.

## Cards and sources

Live Scryfall `cards/named?exact=` printings fetched before implementation;
records in `fixtures/starter-corpus/slice8-sourced.json` with URI and actual
`retrieved_at` (`2026-10-26T12:50:12Z` for the first eight, then the War Strike
fetch time):

| card | source | behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soul's Attendant | roe/44 | optional another-creature-enters gain 1 |
| Razorclaw Bear | p02/142 | becomes blocked → +2/+2 until end of turn |
| Volley Veteran | fdn/550 | ETB damage to target opponent creature = Goblins you control |
| Brightstone Ritual | ons/191 | add {R} for each Goblin on the battlefield |
| Aetherize | fdn/151 | return all attacking creatures to owner's hand |
| Dramatic Reversal | tle/158 | untap all nonland permanents you control |
| Friendly Teddy | dsk/247 | dies → each player draws a card |
| Goblin War Strike | live fetch | target player damage = Goblins you control |

Excluded: Refute (counter+draw+discard needed an effect-discard resumption path
not completed), Snap/Rewind/Sol Ring/Skirk Prospector and other choices with
additional costs or mana-ability timing. They were not added or stubbed.

## Genuine RED

1. Before cards existed: all seven initial slice8 tests failed at
   `catalog::by_name` (`Soul's Attendant must be supported`, etc.).
2. After scaffolding card/catalog data but before effects/abilities:
   * Soul's Attendant optional lifegain — no life change.
   * Razorclaw Bear — never pumped.
   * Volley Veteran — no ETB damage.
   * Brightstone Ritual — no red mana.
   * Aetherize/Dramatic Reversal — no return/untap.
   * Friendly Teddy — no each-player draw.
   * Goblin War Strike — target player took no Goblin-count damage.
3. Test-harness corrections were kept separate from production claims
   (Friendly Teddy P0 hand accounting, War Strike Goblin count, Aetherize blocking
   priority); each was re-run to GREEN.

New primitives: `OpponentCreature` target, `BecomesBlocked` trigger,
`DamageTarget{Creature,Player}ForEachGoblin`, `AddManaForEachGoblin`,
`ReturnAllAttackersToHand`, `UntapAllNonlandsYouControl`, `EachPlayerDraws`,
plus `Kind::Artifact`.

## Verification

```
cargo test -q -p aperture-core --test issue17_slice8 --test issue17_tokens \
  --test issue17_slice6 --test counters_tokens_library --test catalog_pool \
  --test card_printings --test issue13_commander_combat
  -> 8, 10, 13, 16, 5, 5, 43 passed
reviewer224 probe -> 3 passed
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo build --release -p aperture-cli
  -> exit 0 (slice8-gates.log)
```

## Journey

`decks/package-slice8.txt` — 40-card supported package fixture, **not** a
desired 100-card starter. Four seats, Isamaru commander each seat,
Commander-combat 40 life, seed 801:

* terminal, P1 wins, 1600 steps / 40 turns, digest `6fea3673e366…`
* verbose log contains all eight new cards: Soul's Attendant 19, Razorclaw Bear
  15, Volley Veteran 12, Brightstone Ritual 1, Aetherize 2, Dramatic Reversal 1,
  Friendly Teddy 61, Goblin War Strike 1 occurrences
* separate replay matches digest, 4087 events; `--save-out` save replays to the
  same digest (`evidence/issue17/slice8/`)

## Corpus audit

Recomputed with the actual 114-card pool and eight unchanged exact lists:
catalog **114**, union 459, supported **102**, missing **357**, manifest
`missing_cards` matches. Per-list: Isamaru 55, Jasmine 0, Talrand 50, Krenko 48,
Ayula 45, Elas 55, Tatyova 54, Zada 55.

## Gaps

* No 100-card desired starter is complete; all seven non-Jasmine lists remain
  planned and uncertified.
* Refute/Snap/Rewind/Sol Ring/Skirk Prospector and other short-list candidates
  were deliberately not added because complete semantics were not implemented.
* Friendly Teddy's each-player draw uses the existing single-source draw resume;
  commander-draw replacement ordering across multiple simultaneous drawers is
  not separately modelled.
* Existing analyzer gameplay refusal is unchanged; no certification claim.

# Issue 17 slice 8 — six supported cards + two explicit exclusions

Repair after native inspection. Six sourced missing cards are implemented; two
formerly claimed cards are **explicitly excluded** because the printed text is
not fully representable in this bounded engine. No push. Full #17 unfinished.

## Implemented (6)

From exact desired lists, live Scryfall printings recorded in
`fixtures/starter-corpus/slice8-sourced.json`:

| card | source | behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Soul's Attendant | roe/44 | optional another-creature-enters gain 1 |
| Razorclaw Bear | p02/142 | becomes blocked once → +2/+2 until end of turn |
| Volley Veteran | fdn/550 | ETB damage to target opponent creature = Goblins you control |
| Aetherize | fdn/151 | return all attacking creatures to owner’s hand |
| Dramatic Reversal | tle/158 | untap all nonland permanents you control |
| Goblin War Strike | live fetch | target player damage = Goblins you control |

New bounded primitives: `OpponentCreature` target, `BecomesBlocked` trigger,
`DamageTarget{Creature,Player}ForEachGoblin`, `ReturnAllAttackersToHand`,
`UntapAllNonlandsYouControl`.

## Excluded (2, records retained with role/status `excluded`)

* **Brightstone Ritual** — actual Goblin count can exceed 255 and `ManaPool` is a
  saturating `u8`; silently clamps the printed text. Excluded until a bounded
  mana representation exists. Removed from CardId/catalog/effect/tests/package.
* **Friendly Teddy** — `EachPlayerDraws` returned on the first commander-draw
  replacement, losing later players’ draws, and iterated P0.. instead of
  active-player order. Removed rather than approximated; `Kind::Artifact` added
  only for it was also removed. Neither test is claimed as fixed.

Both remain in the manifest missing set via fresh recomputation; desired lists
untouched.

## Genuine RED / controls

Original RED: all slice8 cards absent from catalog; after scaffold, each new
behavior failed before implementation (optional lifegain, blocked pump, Volley
damage, Aetherize return, Reversal untap, War Strike count).

Added controls:
* OpponentCreature target: with two opponent creatures a `TriggerTarget` pending
  is offered; forged self/own-Goblin target is refused with unchanged state
  digest; the legal opponent target succeeds.
* Volley source-left/runtime count: bounce Volley with Unsummon before the
  trigger resolves; X counts the two remaining Goblins and deals lethal 2.
* Razorclaw with two blockers triggers exactly once (power 5, not 7); existing
  one-blocker pump/revert test retained.
* Aetherize asserts each original attacker identity is in hand, no attackers
  remain, and a P1 nonattacker stays on the battlefield.
All drains assert `pending`, `resolving`, `stack` and `trigger_queue` empty.

## Verification

```
cargo test -q -p aperture-core --test issue17_slice8 --test issue17_tokens \
  --test issue17_slice6 --test counters_tokens_library --test catalog_pool \
  --test card_printings --test issue13_commander_combat
  -> 8, 10, 13, 16, 5, 6, 43 passed
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo build --release -p aperture-cli
  -> exit 0
```

## Journey

`decks/package-slice8.txt` was updated to remove the two excluded cards (Shock
and Divination replace them). 40-card supported package, **not** a desired
starter; four seats, Isamaru commander each, 40 life, seed 801:

* terminal, P0 wins, 2319 steps / 61 turns, digest `ffb0e678e8e3…`
* all six implemented cards appear in the verbose log
* separate replay matches, 5792 events; `--save-out` save replays to the same
  digest (`evidence/issue17/slice8/`)

## Corpus audit

New audit only: `evidence/issue17/slice8/corpus-audit.py` →
`evidence/issue17/slice8/corpus-state.json`. Historical
`slice3-native-corpus.{py,json}` restored exactly from `7e1eb5f` and never
rerun for this slice.

Current: catalog **112**, union 459, supported **100**, missing **359**;
manifest `missing_cards` matches. Per-list: Isamaru 55, Jasmine 0, Talrand 50,
Krenko 49, Ayula 46, Elas 55, Tatyova 54, Zada 55.

## Gaps

* No 100-card desired starter is complete; seven remain planned/uncertified.
* Excluded Brightstone Ritual/Friendly Teddy need bounded mana widening and a
  serialized multi-player draw continuation respectively.
* Ayula’s printed counter/tribal text remains unimplemented even though typed
  counters exist from #16.

# Issue 17 slice 12 — artifact mana-rock package handoff

Three sourced artifacts are supported. No push. Full #17 unfinished.

## Implemented

| card | printing | behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sol Ring | frc/21 | `{T}: Add {C}{C}` immediate mana ability |
| Mind Stone | mbc/76 | `{T}: Add {C}`; `{1}, {T}, Sacrifice: Draw a card` |
| Hedron Archive | fdn/726 | `{T}: Add {C}{C}`; `{2}, {T}, Sacrifice: Draw two` |

Live Scryfall named printings fetched before implementation, stored in
`fixtures/starter-corpus/slice12-sourced.json` with printing URL, Scryfall id and
actual UTC `2026-10-26T17:27:16Z`.

**Commander's Sphere excluded**: its mana ability produces a color in the
commander's color identity, which the engine does not evaluate. Not added or
stubbed.

## Engine behavior

* `Kind::Artifact` is a real noncreature permanent kind; artifacts are not
  creatures/lands.
* `CardDef::artifact_mana` declares the CR 605 tap-mana ability. Legal
  activation is immediate: no stack entry and no priority transfer, the source
  actually taps, and a second activation is refused with unchanged state.
* Artifacts do not receive creature summoning sickness; the existing
  priority/pending-choice gate is preserved (no bypassing an existing choice).
* Artifact mana is not auto-paid by the land-only payment planner. Players must
  activate it explicitly; focused tests do, and the heuristic limitation is
  disclosed.
* Mind Stone/Hedron Archive sacrifice-draw abilities are ordinary typed
  activated abilities using the stack, `{1}`/`{2}` generic costs, tap and
  sacrifice-source costs, correct ability index 0, real graveyard movement and
  source-left resolution.

## Genuine RED

Before cards/engine work, all six slice12 tests failed at catalog lookup
(`Sol Ring must be supported`, etc.). After scaffolding card records the
artifact mana/payment tests still failed until `artifact_mana`, the mana-source
scan and the activated abilities existed. No retrospective TDD claim for older
slices.

## Verification

```
cargo test -q -p aperture-core --test issue17_slice12 --test issue17_slice9 \
  --test issue17_tokens --test catalog_pool --test card_printings \
  --test issue13_commander_combat
  -> 7, 6, 10, 5, 6, 43 passed
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy -q --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo build --release -p aperture-cli
  -> exit 0 (evidence/issue17/slice12/gates.log)
```

Tests cover: sourced text/type; immediate Sol Ring mana with no stack/priority;
tapped repeat refusal with state digest unchanged; Mind/Hedron printed mana
amounts; sacrifice-draw stack, zone change and source-left draw; insufficient
mana refusal; artifact noncreature semantics.

## Journey

`decks/package-slice12.txt` — 40-card supported artifact package, not a desired
starter; four seats, Krenko commander each, 40 life, seed 1201:

* terminal, P3 wins, 1746 steps / 42 turns, digest `328dadbdbdc6…`
* separate replay matches 7051 events; save replay matches
* actual artifact activation count in this trace: **0**. Mind Stone/Hedron
  Archive were drawn (and some discarded) but the simple heuristic never cast or
  activated an artifact; focused tests prove activation. No inferred count.

## Corpus audit

New audit only: `evidence/issue17/slice12/corpus-audit.py` →
`corpus-state.json`. Current: catalog **119**, union 459, supported **107**,
missing **352**, manifest matches. Per-list: Isamaru 55, Jasmine 0, Talrand 51,
Krenko 48, Ayula 43, Elas 53, Tatyova 54, Zada 53. Desired snapshots unchanged.
Docs current counts and islandwalk citation (`CR 702.14c`) corrected; historical
checkpoints not rewritten.

## Remaining gaps

No 100-card desired starter is newly certified. Artifact mana is explicit, not
auto-paid by the heuristic; no AI policy edits. Commander's Sphere remains
excluded. Friendly Teddy/Aetherize exclusions and broader legend/equipment/tutor/
reanimation/Ayula gaps remain.

Artifact behavior, source receipts and the representative `d3eade58f133`

remain unsupported. No merge/closure or release/#26/#32 unlock. The handoff’s

real off-battlefield zone remain refused. Ordinary token BF→GY-cessation and
source-left triggers whose source object no longer exists are unchanged.

stack object, stack target, pending trigger choice, resolving, continuous effect
target, and shield target. All are RED before the predicate and GREEN after.

# Issue 17 slice 14 — dynamic mana and threshold

Exact head reported after commit. No merge/master push. Full #17 unfinished:
**125 catalog / 459 union = 113 supported + 346 missing**, 1 certified / 7 planned.

## Sources

Three records extracted from the coordinator’s immutable
`evidence/issue17/slice13/candidate-source.json` (retrieved
`2026-10-26T17:44:38Z`) into `fixtures/starter-corpus/slice14-sourced.json`;
only these three, with Scryfall id/printing URL/retrieval stamp.

* **Arcane Signet** `{2}` Artifact — `{T}: Add one mana of any color in your commander's color identity.`
* **Fellwar Stone** `{2}` Artifact — `{T}: Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce.`
* **Werebear** `{1}{G}` 1/1 Human Bear Druid — `{T}: Add {G}.`; Threshold +3/+3 with ≥7 cards in your graveyard.

## Behavior

* Dynamic colors are explicit legal `ActivateColorManaAbility` actions in stable
  WUBRG order; forged colors are refused before tap/mutation with unchanged
  digest. Activation is immediate (no stack/priority transfer), taps the source.
* Arcane Signet uses registered commander identity only (Isamaru W; Jasmine W/G;
  Krenko R; Talrand U; Tatyova U/G). No commander or empty identity offers no
  colors.
* Fellwar Stone uses live opponent-controlled lands’ typed basic mana types,
  including tapped lands, excludes own lands/artifacts/colorless/eliminated
  players; colors disappear when the land leaves.
* Werebear’s green tap ability is a creature mana ability: summoning sickness
  refuses it, later untap activation works. Threshold is a real layer 7c static
  (+3/+3 while controller has ≥7 cards in graveyard, any card type), updates both
  ways, excludes opponents’ graveyards, and stacks with typed counters and pumps.
* Existing Sol Ring/Mind Stone/Hedron Archive fixed mana behavior and Goblin/
  Drake/Beast/Pest token semantics unchanged.

## Genuine RED

Absent-catalog failure first; after scaffolding cards/fields/action with no
dynamic mana engine, tests failed with offered colors `[]` (Arcane/Fellwar),
Werebear sickness/threshold unavailable — real mechanic RED before implementation.
A test assertion was corrected to match the engine’s correct
“cannot produce red mana here” refusal wording; no production weakening.

## Verification

```
issue17_slice14            5 passed
catalog_pool               5 passed
card_printings             7 passed

issue17_slice13            4 passed
issue17_tokens            10 passed

cargo build --release -p aperture-cli   exit 0
```

## Journey

`decks/package-slice14.txt` — 40-card supported package, not a desired starter;
four seats, Krenko commander each, 40 life, seed 1401:

* terminal, P2 wins, 1391 steps / 34 turns, digest `51fdc345d490…`
* separate replay matches 4304 events; fresh `--save-out` save reloads/replays to
  the same digest
* actual events: **Werebear cast 6 times**; Arcane Signet/Fellwar Stone were
  drawn but not cast/activated; **0 dynamic mana activations** in this product
  heuristic trace. Focused tests prove casts/activations; no inferred counts.

## Corpus/docs

New audit only: `evidence/issue17/slice14/corpus-audit.py` →
`corpus-state.json`. Catalog **125**, union 459, supported **113**, missing
**346**, manifest matches. Per-list: Isamaru 55, Jasmine 0, Talrand 51, Krenko
48, Ayula 39, Elas 53, Tatyova 52, Zada 53. Eight desired snapshots unchanged.
Current docs counts refreshed; historical evidence untouched.

## Remaining gaps

No desired 100-card starter newly certified. Product heuristic ignores artifact
casting and nonland mana activation (evidence-only/focused tests cover it; no AI
policy edit). Commander’s Sphere/Friendly Teddy/Aetherize exclusions and broader
Commander mechanics remain open.

# Slice18 assignment 2 — SAME original writer, bounded 26min, REPAIR before review

Native prepublication inspection of your committed head `9c3a594` found one BLOCKING regression and three concrete defects. Do NOT add new cards or new features this pass. Repair only these, with tests that actually fail first, then focused GREEN, then a fresh journey. At the end amend or add ONE focused commit; parent owns publication.

## 1. BLOCKING — your new `apply_trigger_choice` silently consumes ordinary optional triggers
`crates/core/src/engine.rs::apply_trigger_choice` does:
```rust
if let Some(Pending::TriggerMode { .. }) = self.state.pending.take() { ... }
let Some(Pending::TriggerChoice { .. }) = self.state.pending.take() else { return; };
```
`Option::take()` runs unconditionally, so when the pending is `TriggerChoice` the first `if let` takes it, fails to match, drops the value, and the second `take()` sees `None` and returns. Accepting a "you may" ability no longer sets `trigger_answered`/`resolving`, and declining no longer emits `TriggerDeclined` and no longer pops the ability. This breaks approved pre-existing behavior.

Proved by running your head:
`cargo test -p aperture-core --test abilities` -> `optional_trigger_is_declined_or_used_by_its_controller` FAILED at `crates/core/tests/abilities.rs:391` ("declining is a typed event"), 12 passed 1 failed.

# Issue17 — slice19 human checkpoint

## Increment, not whole-issue acceptance

Same branch `aperture/issue-17`, draft PR46. Resumed from the approved slice-18 head
`21fdefb`. One sourced card, and it is a real subsystem rather than a stat line:

**Spectral Bears** `{1}{G}` — Creature — Bear Spirit 3/3.
Printed: "Whenever this creature attacks, if defending player controls no black
nontoken permanents, it doesn't untap during your next untap step."
Immutable printing `https://api.scryfall.com/cards/e56143db-0274-4878-9d54-619e7f037a33`
(me1 131, Masters Edition), retrieved `2026-10-27T00:54:48Z`, recorded in
`fixtures/starter-corpus/slice19-sourced.json`. The oracle text in the catalog is
byte-equal to that printing.

## What is new in the engine (all required by the printed text)

1. **`TriggerEvent::Attacks` — the pool's first attack trigger.** Declaring
   attackers now queues and stages "whenever this creature attacks" triggers in the
   declare attackers step (CR 508.1), using the existing trigger queue, APNAP order
   and stack machinery. There was no attack-trigger concept before this slice; five
   other Ayula-list cards and most of the corpus need it.
2. **`TriggerCondition` / `ability::trigger_condition` — a printed intervening-if**
   (CR 603.4). It is evaluated *before* the trigger is queued, so a false clause
   never reaches the stack (a `TriggerRemoved` event records why), and it is
   re-checked at resolution, so a clause that stops being true removes the ability.
   It is held per card rather than as a new `TriggeredAbility` field, so all 31
   pre-existing trigger literals are untouched.
3. **`CardDef::is_black`** — printed color from the mana cost (CR 202.2a) or a
   token's own `colors`. Nothing in the pool changes a permanent's color, so this is
   the whole color model this card reads.
4. **`Effect::SkipNextUntapStep` + `GameState::skip_next_untap`** — a one-shot
   "doesn't untap during your next untap step" marker (CR 502.3). The untap step
   consumes it for the affected seat only, leaves the permanent tapped, does *not*
   make it summoning sick, keeps other seats' markers queued, and drops markers for
   objects that already left the battlefield. The set is serde-skipped when empty,
   so every previously recorded digest is unchanged.

## Genuine RED evidence (all three retained)

Each mutation was applied to the committed source, the new suite was run, and the
source was restored from the committed file:

1. `evidence/issue17/slice19/red-mutation-condition-always-true.log` — forcing the
   pre-queue intervening-if to `true` fails **exactly**
   `a_black_nontoken_permanent_on_defense_stops_the_trigger` (4 passed, 1 failed).
2. `evidence/issue17/slice19/red-mutation-untap-ignores-restriction.log` — making
   the untap step ignore the marker fails the two tests that assert the restriction
   (3 passed, 2 failed).
3. `evidence/issue17/slice19/red-mutation-resolution-recheck-disabled.log` — forcing
   the resolution-time re-check to `true` fails **exactly**
   `the_printed_condition_is_rechecked_when_the_trigger_resolves` (5 passed,
   1 failed). This branch was untested in the first cut and an independent review
   caught it; it now has its own discriminating control.

So the tests discriminate the printed semantics, not merely the presence of a card.

## Executed verification (native, this run)

- `crates/core/tests/issue17_slice19.rs` — 6 focused tests: registration against the
  printed text, the trigger firing against a black-free defender (attacker stays
  tapped through exactly one untap step while a bystander untaps, then untaps
  normally on the following turn), a black **nontoken** permanent stopping the
  trigger, a black **token** not stopping it, a nonattacking bear never being
  marked, and the resolution-time re-check removing the ability when the defending
  board gains a black nontoken permanent while the trigger is on the stack.
- Workspace gates: `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked --no-fail-fast`,
  `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`,
  `cargo build --workspace --release --locked`, `cargo fmt --all --check`.
  `evidence/issue17/slice19/gates.log` is produced by
  `evidence/issue17/slice19/run-gates.sh` and records a per-step exit code; no gate
  result is inherited or asserted by hand.
- Real four-seat journey (evidence-only masked demonstrator, **not** product AI):
  `evidence/issue17/slice19/demo-journey.json` — exact 4 seats / 40 life / 40-card
  package `decks/package-slice19.txt` / seed 1919, **1773 actions, 42 turns**,
  terminal `Win{P3}`, **4709 replay events** with a matching separately-run replay
  digest `5fd841b2…a19f5d`, and a fresh-save roundtrip asserted in the driver.
  Spectral Bears was cast 5 times, its attack trigger was staged 14 times, and the
  untap restriction was observed in 13 real untap steps (it is not a paper claim:
  the driver asserts all three counts).
